pages.text: $(thing)Xaero's Minimap$() and $(thing)World Map$() are the pack's navigation. A small map sits on screen. The full-screen map shows everywhere you have explored. Both are client side; nothing is needed on a server.

pages.title: Xaero's Maps
pages.text: Waypoints can be set from either map. Right-click the world map for options such as a temporary waypoint or sharing a location in chat. Zoom the minimap in its settings.

pages.title: Death Points
pages.text: When you die a Latest Death waypoint is made for you, and older deaths can be kept. Check the minimap settings to tune this.

Waypoint names can be shared to chat, so teammates can add them. Be careful not to expose a secret base.$(br2)Keybinds are listed in Controls under the Xaero categories. Open the settings from the minimap or the Mods menu.

pages.title: Trains and Airships
pages.text: Xaero Train Map shows Create train lines and stations on the world map. Create - Xaero's map draws Sable-based vehicles like airships live, with rotation.$(br)$(l:transport/trains)Trains$(/l) $(l:flight/airships)Airships$(/l)

Create Railways Navigator adds a Navigator item and Advanced Display boards for stations, to plan and show train routes. It complements the map.$(br2)Long trips by air or sea: $(l:flight/destinations)Destinations$(/l).
